name: Ember Driftwood
description: Charred driftwood and hemp rope glowing amber against a tobacco-dark gradient.
lighting: Warm tungsten rim light, ember glow, dark vignette
subject: either
prompt: Two logs of charred driftwood cross the foreground on a diagonal, their cracked black surfaces glowing a deep ember orange along the edges as if still warm. Between them a flat slab of weathered grey driftwood makes a level resting place, lashed with a loop of coarse undyed hemp rope. The background is a smooth gradient from burnt orange at the centre to deep tobacco brown at the edges. Warm rim light from behind outlines every edge of wood and rope, and a dark vignette closes the corners. The palette is amber, ember, tobacco and black, warm and smoky.
